title: When onion cost more at the source
summary: Lasalgaon → Azadpur, January 2025: a ₹-231 per quintal median price gap on 27 matched days. After modeled costs: −₹717 per quintal on the typical day.
why_selected: Chosen automatically for January 2025: one of AGRINET's documented trade corridors with 27 matched report days.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices; sale matched to the first destination report 1–3 days after transit
caveats: Hypothetical: no actual shipment is claimed.
Modal prices may mix varieties and grades (mostly FAQ).
Costs are survey values and assumptions, not quotes.
OSRM car profile; truck route not verified.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Lasalgaon (Nashik) is India's best-known onion auction; Azadpur (Delhi) is the largest terminal market it feeds, a link the RBI paper describes.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: On 27 matched days, Lasalgaon reported a median ₹2,350 per quintal; Azadpur reported ₹1,969 2 days later.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹-231/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gross gap was ₹-231 per quintal and was positive on 4% of days.

scenes.headline: 1,115 km by road
scenes.caption: Routed road distance 1,115 km (OpenStreetMap car routing, ~13 driving hours). Trucks are slower; we allow 2 days.

scenes.headline: Now add the costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹240/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. Modeled net on the typical (median) day: −₹717 per quintal.

scenes.headline: Stress test
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day becomes −₹887 per quintal.

scenes.headline: Hindsight vs. a real trader
scenes.caption: With perfect hindsight, 0 of 27 days cleared modeled costs. A trader using only reports available on the day would not have shipped on any of 27 days.

scenes.headline: The lesson
scenes.caption: Here the source market was dearer than the destination on most days. Produce would not have flowed this way on price alone.

assumptions.value: scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹240/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days

conclusion: Here the source market was dearer than the destination on most days. Produce would not have flowed this way on price alone.
